# Daily Math Puzzle

> A free maths site: a new puzzle every day, a smart blackboard that reads handwriting, plots, solves and does geometry, and formula cheat sheets. In English, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

AI assistants can teach on the blackboard through MCP: create a board, give the student its link, and draw the explanation step by step while they watch live.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in): https://dailymathpuzzle.com/api/mcp.php
- Tools: board_guide, create_board, draw, get_board

## Docs

- [Blackboard guide for AI assistants](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/board-guide.md): every drawing command, the maths syntax, layout and a full example
- [Connecting an assistant](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/mcp.html): Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients
